newsitem.title: USA: CoreComm extends $200 mln note exchange.
newsitem.headline: CoreComm extends $200 mln note exchange.

text.p: CoreComm Inc's subsidiary CCPR Services Inc said Monday it extended its offer to swap $200 million of restricted notes into unrestricted bonds to July 29, 1700 EDT/2100 GMT.
The company is exchanging the 10 percent senior subordinated notes due 2007, which are restricted to certain qualified institutional buyers, for public notes.
"It's much easier to trade them," a spokesman said. "Institutional buyers essentially require (companies) to swap restricted notes after a couple of years because of (liquidity concerns)."
